name: @3m5-de/squirrel-select
description: A stylesheet for the native <select>. No JavaScript.

scripts.lint: eslint scripts tests playwright.config.ts eslint.config.mjs stylelint.config.mjs && stylelint "src/**/*.css"
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run size && npm run pack:check
scripts.test:browser:docker: npm run build && docker run --rm --init --ipc=host -u "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp -e CI -v "$(pwd):/work" -w /work mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v$(node -p "require('./node_modules/@playwright/test/package.json').version")-noble npx playwright test
